archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: APP-SBB-002: OmniStudio (Standard Runtime)
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation: Physical Application Component (Plataforma OmniStudio) (SBB) - Suite declarativa de Salesforce (antes Vlocity) donde viven OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures y Data Mappers. En org: 78 OmniProcess activos (10 OmniScripts, 68 Integration Procedures), 5 FlexCards activas, 167 Data Mappers (APP-SBB-033). Realiza ABB: APP-ABB-001 a APP-ABB-006.
